column1: # PostgreSQL 17.11 (postgres:17-alpine, wadjet-pg-un4) answers for TestArcUNExchangeKeepsThePrinterEveryArm over un_x, un_u; same form as arc_un_unconstrained_pg17.tsv. The six renderer cells over a UNION (distinct) derived table are left out: on the DAG arms the outer projection over it is dropped (type numeric, a sort key on it missing) at c67ebf5b and at this tip alike — a defect of its own (filing candidate UN-F9), not of the printer.
